_: DESIGN §4.8 — the one-tap slot. ONE special is loaded at a time and an Ordnance crate swaps it mid-mission (§4.4), which is the reason to take a crate you did not think you needed. `impl` says who owns the EFFECT: P6 owns the slot itself and the shotgun shell, because cutting a canopy in one shot is a crate rule; the other five are weapons and flares and belong to P13's hangar and P14's modes. A row with impl != 'p6' is live data with no effect wired, and it is declared here rather than stubbed silently.

slot.button: bottom-right, 108 px radius, mirrored on left-handed (DESIGN §2.2)

specials.name: Shotgun shell
specials.desc: One wide blast. Cuts a canopy in a single shot.

specials.name: Le Prieur rockets
specials.desc: Eight rockets, straight, and they eat balloons.

specials.name: Cooper bombs
specials.desc: Four, released along the flight path with real gravity.

specials.name: Flare
specials.desc: Lights a 180 m radius for 14 s, and drifts with the wind.
specials._note: §4.6.3 'Both Sides of the Line' is built on this: four flares cannot cover twelve crates, so information is the scarce resource. The drift uses the same wind profile a crate does — `windAt` in js/sim/crates.js — and must not grow a second copy.

specials.name: Emergency boost
specials.desc: +55% thrust for 5 s. The engine takes 3 damage a second while it is lit.

specials.name: Smoke
specials.desc: A decoy trail. Breaks every enemy lock for 4 s.
